item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Medication. You already have a morning slot set aside for your diabetes meds and your cholesterol injection, so the plan exists. The risk is treating it as automatic. Take it at the same time, confirm it's done, and don't assume. If you miss a dose, don't double up. Check your instructions or call your pharmacist. Tonight, glance at tomorrow's supply. Action: after your morning dose, mark it done right away.
